samuel-brown.summary: A cheap Jandar sharpshooter who can shoot first and then charge in to finish the job.
brings: Fire and Rush is new to the pool: hit something within 5 spaces with 3 dice, and if it takes a wound he can move 5 and attack again with 4 dice. No other figure combines a ranged hit with a follow-up melee rush.
A second budget Range 7 Jandar hero (60 pts). The only other is Johnny "Shotgun" Sullivan, who swings with just 2 attack dice to Samuel's 3.
Valiant, so he fits all-Valiant armies: 4th Massachusetts Line's defense bonus and Gnarlfur Raiders' Mighty Hero Bonding both count him.
samuel-brown.watchOut: Fire and Rush only works if he starts his turn unengaged, and with Life 4 / Defense 3 he can't stay in melee for long.

necrotech-wraithriders.summary: The fastest squad in the pool, built to drag enemy figures out of position.
brings: Move 8 — no other squad in the pool moves more than 7.

Chain Grab on every rider: each of the three can try to pull an enemy small or medium figure from up to 3 spaces away (9+ on the d20), with no leaving-engagement attacks. Until now only the 25-point Drow Chainfighter and the Wyvern could reposition enemies like this.
Revna's third unit (after Hellforge Mandukor and Killian Vane III) and only the second Eisenek, so it feeds Hellforge Mandukor's Feed the Forge and works with its Eisenek Advance.
necrotech-wraithriders.watchOut: Rolling Movement stops them climbing more than 2 levels at a time, so tall maps slow them down, and Life 2 / Defense 3 riders go down quickly.
